summary: All checks pass. No previous findings were raised, so none remain unresolved. All unchanged text was already reviewed and cleared. All four subsections match the plan exactly: workflow elements (role, input, decision, record, exception), evaluation criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are present throughout. ICC Safety capability claims are consistently framed as published descriptions requiring demonstration confirmation. The Ontario JHSC guide is cited only where Ontario-specific content applies, with appropriate jurisdictional caveats in every instance. Links use only the two supplied source URLs (icc-safety and ontario-jhsc-guide). No FAQ section appears, consistent with the plan assigning none to any subsection of this chapter. No scope boundary violations, readability problems, or problematic repetition were detected. Word count of approximately 2018 is within acceptable range of the 2000-word target.
